usage: cox stats system-one [-h] [--role ROLE] [--since SINCE] [--json] [--propose]
                            [--plans-dir PLANS_DIR]
                            [runs_dir]

positional arguments:
  runs_dir

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --role ROLE           report this role only
  --since SINCE         keep only rows dated on or after DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --json
  --propose             write a graduation proposal for each READY role; never edits a profile
  --plans-dir PLANS_DIR
                        where --propose writes system-one-graduation-<role>-<date>.md
